picks.title: How artificial neural networks build their own learning machinery
picks.excerpt: MIT neuroscientists showed that a randomly connected artificial neural network, given simple rules about how and when connections should change, can reshape itself into an efficient self-supervised learning system.
picks.rationale: Fresh MIT McGovern result on how simple plasticity rules let a random network self-organize into a self-supervised learner; basic neuroscience x AI, not covered before.

picks.title: Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics
picks.excerpt: Google says Gemini 4 Argon leads the ERQA embodied-reasoning benchmark, with physical reasoning, zero-shot robot control, Real2Sim and agentic workflows for robotics.
picks.rationale: New primary-source model release for embodied reasoning and zero-shot robot control (Real2Sim); highest-novelty item in the pool, from the lab itself.

picks.title: New detector spots AI-generated work by examining ideas, not words
picks.excerpt: University of Maryland, Google DeepMind and SFU researchers built IdeaLens, which judges whether a text's ideas came from AI, catching 91% of fully AI-written documents with a 0.6% false-alarm rate.
picks.rationale: IdeaLens detects AI authorship at the idea level with hard numbers (91% recall, 0.6% false alarms); a new method, distinct from the earlier optical deepfake detector.

picks.title: Rangers reimagine AI in wildlife monitoring
picks.excerpt: Indigenous rangers in West Arnhem, Australia, with CDU and CSIRO researchers, ran the MegaDetector AI model on about 1,572 hours of camera-trap footage and cut the images needing human review by roughly 81%.
picks.rationale: Field ecology deployment of MegaDetector by Indigenous rangers with a concrete 81% review-load cut; a different project and method from yesterday's LLM citizen-science card.

picks.title: Scientists worry AI is stealing their ideas
picks.excerpt: Researchers are using AI as a sounding board throughout their work, but concerns are growing that companies may present users' ideas as those of their models.
picks.rationale: Timely look at idea attribution when researchers brainstorm with AI; pairs with the IdeaLens card and is a different angle from the 9/29 'when can AI claim a discovery' piece.
